name: jg-packages
description: Jesus Graterol's personal npm packages, built, tested, and released from one pnpm and Turborepo monorepo.
author: Jesus Graterol

scripts.check: node internal/vitest-config/src/run-test-suite.ts full run lint typecheck build test:coverage test:e2e && node internal/vitest-config/src/run-test-suite.ts full run test:browser && pnpm format:check && pnpm release:verify
scripts.check:essential: node internal/vitest-config/src/run-test-suite.ts essential run lint typecheck build test:unit test:integration test:browser test:e2e && pnpm format:check
scripts.test: node internal/vitest-config/src/run-test-suite.ts essential run test:unit test:integration test:e2e
scripts.test:full: node internal/vitest-config/src/run-test-suite.ts full run test:unit test:integration test:e2e
